name: floats
title: Floating-point behavior
measures: 0.1 + 0.2, large plus small magnitudes, repeated accumulation, float32 rounding, signed zero, infinities, NaN comparisons, and number formatting.
notes: float64 is IEEE double on both sides and every float64 line agrees. TypeScript has no float32: the TS version rounds with Math.fround (ES2015; TypeScript 1.0's library doesn't declare it, so it is reached through any) wherever RuneScript computes in float32. Intended divergence (expected/test.ts.out): RuneScript prints a float32 as the shortest text that reads back as the same float32 (0.1), while TypeScript can only print the double it holds (0.10000000149011612). The values are equal.
